scenarioSurface.scenarioName: Bind source selection intent to an admitted acquisition port

input.text: admitted source-selection intent, media constraints, state and event bindings, and a source-acquisition port

outcome.text: role, constraints, multiplicity, state, consent, commit, port, and lineage are preserved without acquiring or interpreting source bytes

scenarioSurface.notes:
Source selection presentation declares a source role, accepted media facts,
  multiplicity, state binding, commit event, consent copy, and source-acquisition
  port. Projection must not open, read, decode, upload, or otherwise acquire a
  source inside the presentation capability.
